subject: Schedule Change Notification - $module_code: Room Updated
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

This email is to inform you that there has been a change to the room location for $module_code - $module_name.

=== Schedule Change Details ===

Change Type: Room Location Change

Schedule Information:
- Day: $day_of_week
- Time: $start_time - $end_time
- Session Type: $session_type
- Instructor: $instructor_name

Previous Location: $old_room_location
New Location: $new_room_location

=== Action Required ===

Please make note of the new room location and ensure you go to the correct location for your next session. We recommend arriving a few minutes early if you're unfamiliar with the new location.

=== Important Notes ===

- This change is effective immediately
- Please verify the room location before your next session
- Campus maps are available at: www.university.edu/maps

If you have any questions or concerns about this schedule change, please contact:
- Module Coordinator: $coordinator_email
- Academic Office: academic.office@university.edu

Thank you for your understanding.

$signature
